ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var requestHeaders = attributes.headers --- { "client_secret": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client_secret'), "client_id": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client_id'), "name": requestHeaders.name, "X-CORRELATION-ID": requestHeaders."X-CORRELATION-ID", "source": requestHeaders.source, "systemId": requestHeaders.systemId }

when.expression: #[isEmpty(vars.inputPayload.attributeSynchronization default []) and isEmpty(vars.inputPayload.productSynchronization default []) and isEmpty(vars.inputPayload.offerSynchronization default []) and isEmpty(vars.inputPayload.offerRelaSynchronization default [])]

raise-error.description: There was an error trying to process Billing Product Synchronization information

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = "everywhere" --- { transactionId: vars.transactionId, createDate: vars.inputPayload.createDate, message: payload }

logger.doc:name: Attribute No Recibido
logger.message: AttributeSynchronization was not received or is empty

logger.doc:name: Product No Recibido
logger.message: ProductSynchronization was not received or is empty

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = "everywhere" --- { transactionId: vars.transactionId, createDate: vars.inputPayload.createDate, message: { offerList: (vars.inputPayload.offerSynchronization default []) map (offer) -> { id: offer.id, offerType: offer.offerType, offerName: offer.offerName, offerCode: offer.offerCode, effDate: offer.effDate, expDate: offer.expDate, effType: offer.effType, saleListPrice: offer.saleListPrice, rentListPrice: offer.rentListPrice, bundleFlag: offer.bundleFlag, prodCode: offer.prodCode, effDurationPeriod: offer.effDuration, effDurationUnit: offer.effDurationType, comments: offer.comments, operate: offer.operate, (offerAttrList: (offer.offerAttrList default []) map (attribute) -> { id: attribute.id, offerCode: attribute.offerCode, attrCode: attribute.attrCode, defaultValue: attribute.defaultValue, operate: attribute.operate }) if (offer.offerAttrList?) } } }

logger.doc:name: Offer No Recibido
logger.message: OfferSynchronization was not received or is empty

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = "everywhere" --- do { var bundleList = vars.inputPayload.offerRelaSynchronization flatMap (sync) -> (sync.bundleMemberList default []) map (item) -> { syncType: "bundleMember", bundleOfferCode: item.bundleOfferCode, bundleOfferName: item.bundleOfferName, memMainOfferCode: item.memMainOfferCode, memMainOfferName: item.memMainOfferName, operate: item.operate } var mainOfferList = vars.inputPayload.offerRelaSynchronization flatMap (sync) -> (sync.mainOfferMemberList default []) map (item) -> { syncType: "mainOffer", mainOfferCode: item.mainOfferCode, mainOfferName: item.mainOfferName, memAddOfferCode: item.memAddOfferCode, memAddOfferName: item.memAddOfferName, operate: item.operate } --- flatten(bundleList + mainOfferList) }

logger.doc:name: Offer Relation No Recibido
logger.message: OfferRelaSynchronization was not received or is empty

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { responseCode: payload.result.result.responseCode, responseMessage: payload.result.result.responseMessage, (syncType: vars.syncType) if !isEmpty(vars.syncType) }

%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { responseCode: (error.errorMessage.payload.status) default "9999", responseMessage: (error.errorMessage.payload.message) default (error.description) default ('Error processing ' ++ (vars.syncTypeLabel default "sync")), (syncType: vars.syncType) if !isEmpty(vars.syncType) }
